title: nana beemar nahi maa zakhmi aey
body:
Nana di qabar te kehnde rae ro ro ke Hassan Hussain
Tur chali ay Nana dunya tun teri dhi tere dil da chain
Atun apne zulm chupaon layi darbari aekhu kehan
Beemar ae taiyun kerdi ae dhi paak nabi di wen
<<DIVIDER>>
Nana beemar nai maa zakhmi ae
Jis roz toon buha dugya ae
Hat paase te rakh ke
Bus rondhi rehndi ae
<<DIVIDER>>
Tehreer te tukre jis din de
Darbaro naal liyai
Rab jane kis tayari layi
Har tukre di sitran
<<DIVIDER>>
Zainab nun sunandi ae
Zainab diyan banwan te umri
De de ke bose akhe
Ae si darbar madine da
<<DIVIDER>>
Oo sham ae Zainab
Teri peshi ookhi ae Ki haal dasaa tun janda aen
Darwaza heath se amri
Bus ae das daan teri ummat
<<DIVIDER>>
Darwaza tun Nana
Turdi hui guzri ae
Raatan di khmoshi de ander
Jiven gunjan azanaan
<<DIVIDER>>
Oodhi pasliyan de do huwan di
Awaaz wi Nana
Yasrab wich gunjhi ae
Ae wen si mere babe da
<<DIVIDER>>
Haye kaash Ali mar janda
Umri nal hui gustakhi
Tre veer Ali ne
Ankhiyan nal wekhi ae
<<DIVIDER>>
Akber shabbir ne ven Kita
Yaqoob wi khoon se roya
Jinhan yousuf layi oo roya si
Maa roz hee oonan
<<DIVIDER>>
Mohsin layi rondhi ae
Jadun putar de samne umri de
Chehre te aya neel ae
Is roz tun iztan wali maa
<<DIVIDER>>
Mere veer Hassan de
Nayi samne andhi ae
